_comment: Merge this into your Claude Desktop config, then restart Claude Desktop. On Windows the file lives at %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. IMPORTANT: the Data API (uvicorn data_api.main:app --port 8000) must be running, because the MCP server fetches from it over HTTP. Use the absolute path to your venv python for reliability, e.g. ...\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe
